spec_conflict_interpretation: Accepted interpretation of REQ-03/REQ-05 (locked decision 4): the semantic fault_tape_spec deliberately carries no concrete operation_key. logical_run_id is derived from this semantic descriptor first; then the concrete key op/<logical_run_id>/step-<decimal>/intent-<token> is expanded and persisted in the resolved fault tape. The pre-resolution RunConfig.fault_tape_spec and the resolved tape differ by exactly this expansion; this must not be silently changed.
